licence.title: Physician Assistant (PA, PA-C)
licence.renewalDeadline: June 30 of odd-numbered years; no grace period

ce.categoryRules: All 50 hours Category I: at least 8 Category 1 hours on pharmacology plus at least 42 further Category I hours, earned in the 2 years before licence expiration. First renewal after initial licensure or reinstatement: only the 8 pharmacology hours. Keep documentation 6 years; civil penalty up to $100 per missing hour.

topicMandates.topic: Prescribing or dispensing controlled dangerous substances
topicMandates.appliesTo: Maryland CDS registrants, before first CDS registration or first CDS renewal on or after 2018-10-01

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 2 hours one-time for Maryland CDS registration (OCSA)

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Since 2024-10-01 (PA Modernization Act): execute a collaboration agreement with one or more Maryland-licensed patient care team physicians, notify the Board through the Practitioner Profile before practising; the agreement is kept at the primary practice location (not submitted, not board-approved, no fee), separate agreement per employer, valid until terminated; retain records 5 years after termination. Pre-October 2024 delegation agreements remain valid as collaboration agreements.
practice.notes: Advanced duties need board approval unless performed in an exempt facility, previously approved, or the PA has over 7,000 clinical practice hours. A patient care team physician may collaborate with no more than 8 PAs at a time outside hospitals, correctional facilities, detention centers and public health facilities.

prescribing.separateAuthorityNote: Prescriptive authority (including CDS) is delegated in the collaboration agreement with attestations (NCCPA exam passed within 2 years or 8 Category I pharmacology hours within 2 years; bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2 years PA experience). No separate board registration. CDS needs a Maryland CDS registration (OCSA, 3-year application) plus DEA, and PDMP registration before a new or renewal CDS registration.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 8 Category 1 pharmacology hours every cycle (all PAs); 2 hours CDS one-time for OCSA registration

rn.ceNote: Active renewal needs one of: 1,000 hours of active nursing practice in the prior 5 years, OR a Board-approved nursing diploma/degree in the prior 5 years, OR 30 CEUs in the prior 2 years. CEUs do not carry forward.

practice.transitionNote: A new NP (never certified by any Board of Nursing) identifies a designated mentor (Maryland NP or physician with 3 or more years experience) for 18 months; this is a mentor relationship, not an hours count.
